spec.assertion: it.skip — no stat/damage/duration payload and the sim has no aim-state axis; only auditable requirement is that it appears in `unmodeled.skill1` (asserted in the cross-cutting group). Nearest-wrong would be inventing a hit-rate or fire-rate buff, which the ALWAYS-⚑ rule forbids.

Proves trigger=fullBurstEnd (not fullBurstEnter/burstCast), target=allies, seconds=7.48, and oncePerBattle absent; plus a behavioural check that deleting it cannot increase Full Bursts and must reduce FB count or team damage. Fails under a one-shot CDR, a self-only target, or an FB-enter re-key.

Proves per-ally-per-FB application count (batches === fullBurstStart count × distinct targets), a 600-frame expiry (10 s, not permanent), attackDamagePct not atkPct (bucket scope), and that zeroing it lowers a NON-carrier ally's total. Fails under self-only scope, burstCast keying, missing durationSec, or atkPct mis-encoding.

Proves trigger kind teamAmmo with count 400 (not hitCount, which counts only her own rounds) and fillGauge pct 37; deletion must strictly reduce the Full Burst count. Fails under a hitCount mis-key (fires far less often on a 120-round SMG) or a modelled-but-inert gauge effect.

Proves a boss-held debuff (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null) at value 5.05 with no durationSec, and that zeroing the damageTakenPct effects lowers EVERY ally's total. Fails if encoded as a self buff (teammates unmoved) or given a finite duration.

Proves exactly TWO independent 5.05% damageTakenPct effects (not one merged 10.1%), with triggers {passive, hitCount:50}, and that the second application frame is strictly later than the first. Fails under merging (over-credits the opening 50 rounds), under a teamAmmo mis-key, or if the Explosive Bubble is dropped.

it.skip — the stun targets the ENEMY and the v1 boss neither fires nor reloads, so the `stun` primitive (which models a NIKKE unable to act) has no observable payload; "Removes Bubble" has no consumer once both Damage Taken lines are continuous.

Proves interval{sec:1} + fbGate 'inFb' + exactly 4 flatDamage effects of 63.36% each; every emitted rider damage event carries inFullBurst===true; deletion lowers only her total and leaves every teammate byte-identical. Fails under a bare interval (≈10× over-credit across 180 s), a fullBurstEnter re-key (fires once per FB instead of ~10×), or a merged 253.44% single hit.

Proves a SECOND, distinct teamAmmo trigger at count 500 with 10 flatDamage effects of 85% each, that it actually fires in 180 s (deletion strictly lowers her total), and that it is enemy-facing only (teammates byte-identical). Fails if merged onto the skill1 400-counter or keyed to her own ammo.
Proves multi-target application (distinct targetSlug > 1) with a 600-frame window, and that zeroing it lowers a non-carrier ally. Fails under self-only scope or a permanent-duration encoding.

Proves exactly one instantReload with fraction≈0.3326 on an allies-targeted block. This is a shot-economy (damage-relevant) line; nearest-wrong models are dropping it as defensive or encoding fraction 1 (a full reload), both of which this fails.

Proves stat casterAtkPct (flat add) not atkPct (target-scaled), self-only target set (exactly one distinct targetSlug === little-mermaid), and the FLAT-resolved emitted value ≈ 0.1728 × 98,367 (Supporter static ATK @ Base 5). Zeroing it moves her total and no teammate's. Fails under atkPct mis-encoding, an allies target, or asserting the raw 17.28 percentage.

No kit line says "core strike damage", so every non-normal damage event from her must carry coreRate 0. Fails under core:true riders, which would inflate the 63.36% and 85% hits by the core multiplier.

fixtures: controlComp('little-mermaid', true) — a single deterministic 180 s run plus one re-run per counterfactual (9 runs total, well under the ~20-run budget). She is Burst I, so the control comp's B2 + B3 slots are what make the chain cast at all; the fixed-B3 helm slot is KEPT because this kit is overwhelmingly Full-Burst-keyed (FB-enter buff, FB-end CDR, the 1 s in-FB rider) and dropping a B3 would cost Full Bursts and make several gates vacuous. Nothing in this kit reads a teammate-specific stat, so helm's buffs cannot confound any assertion: every check is either a structural read of the override, an event-identity/count check, or a same-comp A/B delta where only one block is mutated. Two explicit non-vacuity guards run first — the fight must reach Full Burst (and she must cast her own burst), and the fight must contain BOTH in-FB and out-of-FB damage — so the fbGate and FB-keyed assertions are not testing an empty set.
gaps: skill1 'Activates only when in Focusing status. Focuses fire continuously.' — no stat, no damage, no duration; the sim has no aim-state/focus axis (hit-rate is handled by the HRCORE geometry, not a kit toggle). Nothing observable to assert; must be recorded in unmodeled.skill1 rather than invented as a hit-rate or fire-rate buff.

skill2 Explosive Bubble 'Stuns for 3 sec' — the stun targets the ENEMY; the v1 boss is not an acting entity (it never fires, charges or reloads), so the `stun` primitive has no observable payload here. Only the Damage Taken component is damage-relevant.

skill2 Explosive Bubble 'Removes Bubble' — a status-bookkeeping line with no consumer: both Damage Taken instances are 'continuously', so removing the Bubble status changes no modelled quantity. Would only matter if a future block gated on Bubble status.
